ai.seo_question: Who are the people promised divine help in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Manṣūrūn* (the victorious), particularly emphasizing the steadfastness of the Imams and their followers in the face of opposition. It underscores the communal discipline and unity required for divine support, reflecting the historical reality of early Muslim battles and the spiritual rank of the Ahl al-Bayt. The promise of victory is not merely military but spiritual, ensuring that those who maintain their ranks in faith ultimately prevail.
